purpose: Determine whether vLLM #64674 is identity- or task-family-overlapping with previously exposed Development/Train tasks, using only frozen public metadata and the already recorded exposure ledger. This review does not qualify source behavior or authorize model inference.

allowed_inputs: candidate identity, title, changed-path metadata, and immutable revision metadata
recorded Development and Train task-family descriptions and exposure classifications
prior overlap-review rationales for vLLM #64575 and #64830
prohibited_inputs: candidate PR body or issue discussion
candidate patch, source, tests, task prompt, or grader assets
any Held-Out task identity, source, test, grader, or outcome

overlap_requires_at_least_one: a shared changed source component or directly shared test target
the same underlying behavior contract or defect mechanism based on frozen task-family descriptions
insufficient_for_overlap: shared words such as tool, parser, validation, or streaming without a shared contract or component

limitations: A no-overlap decision is not a source qualification and does not establish upstream regression validity.
Source-level freshness does not establish model pretraining non-exposure.
The review cannot establish performance generalization across repositories.
